title: Yemeni separatist chief fled to UAE, Saudi-led coalition says
summary: Yemeni separatist leader Aidarous Al-Zubaidi has fled to the United Arab Emirates with Emirati help after a failed military advance that strained relations between the Gulf countries, the country's Saudi-led coalition said on Thursday. Al-Zubaidi was accused of high treason and removed from Yemen's Presidential Leadership Council on Wednesday.
